title: Verify shared machine approval separately
text: Machines and the selected-code route now share the pending list and approval card in source, including identity, local expiry, outcomes and return-to-terminal guidance. Standalone hosted beta, organization creation and source captures do not prove real admission. The hosted consumer must use the exact engine candidate before the Inbox mirror can retire, with zero pending mirrored requests. Deployed proof must preserve local reachability and the person's approval authority; the separate admission journey campaign remains owed.
